evidence.observation: EXAMPLE BREW STAND is a fictional modern specialty coffee stand.
The listed hours are 8:00–17:00 and closed days are irregular.

references.observed_principle: An official brand graphic balances assertive dark lettering with limited cream space.
references.transferable_idea: Use type weight and rhythm rather than its specific dots, logo or coffee branding.

decisions.choice: Horizontal wordmark sits as a crisp mid-size masthead over a slim grid of opening-time information.
decisions.rationale: Early opening (8:00) is the most useful verified fact for a stand, so it sits next to the name instead of below the fold.

decisions.choice: Condensed, architectural sans hierarchy with compact uppercase name, few typographic sizes and clear breathing room.
decisions.rationale: A Latin all-caps name and a short fact set suit a compact sans hierarchy with few sizes.

decisions.choice: Ink-black over almost-white with one restrained cool sage rule; no borrowed coffee-brand browns.
decisions.rationale: Nothing in the fixture states a colour; a neutral ink/paper base with one cool rule avoids importing a reference brand's browns.

decisions.choice: No fabricated bean or shop photos; use real typographic contrast as the sole visual focus.
decisions.rationale: The menu names exist but no approved images do, so contrast in type replaces any invented drink or bean photo.

decisions.choice: One highly ordered headline area, then staggered information blocks with visible baseline offsets.
decisions.rationale: With a medium fact set (hours, irregular closing, address, four menu names), short staggered blocks fit better than long sections.

decisions.choice: Two factual anchors: identity and operating hours; no invented product promises or transaction controls.
decisions.rationale: Irregular closed days make hours the fact a visitor checks first, so it gets one of only two anchors.

decisions.choice: Stack labels above hours, preserve unbroken readable Latin name and generous tap targets.
decisions.rationale: The English name breaks badly if wrapped mid-word, and hours must remain tappable-sized on a phone.

decisions.choice: Sharp CSS grid, hairline borders and a deliberate white-on-ink interaction state, no image assets.
decisions.rationale: With no assets, grid lines and borders carry the structure; this keeps the build to HTML/CSS checked by existing gates.
